MATTER AND PHASE

Structures from image gradients, real/imaginary nodal sheets and candidate phase winding cells.

WHAT YOU ARE SEEING
The RGB cloud comes from the model's original output. The nodal surfaces are places where Re(Z)=0 or Im(Z)=0. Golden filaments show grid cells with phase winding around a small loop. Their geometry is not imposed by the display.

A feature near a Riemann zero is not automatically caused by that zero. The red markers are references only.
